title: SDP Authority Constraint
description: A single bound on an Authority Record grant. Every constraint declares a decidability class (A deterministic, B classifier-mediated, C human-judgment) per SDP-0003. Only Class A constraints may be registry-facing.

class.description: Decidability class. A: deterministic. B: classifier-mediated. C: human judgment.

type.description: Predicate type. Class A types are enumerated below; class B uses 'Classifier'; class C uses 'HumanJudgment'.

registry_facing.description: Whether this constraint is published for third-party verification. MUST be false unless class is 'A'.

window.description: ISO 8601 duration for the aggregation window (AggregateCap, RateLimit).

dimension.description: What is summed or counted (AggregateCap): 'amount', 'count', or a named exposure dimension.

taxonomy.description: Code system identifier, e.g. 'UNSPSC', 'MCC', 'ISIC' (EnumConstraint, Jurisdiction). Required for EnumConstraint.

taxonomy_version.description: Pinned taxonomy version. REQUIRED for Class A category constraints; an unpinned reference is not Class A.

codes.description: Permitted code set (EnumConstraint, Jurisdiction, AllowList) or prohibited set (DenyList, Exclusion).

classifier_id.description: Classifier identity (Class B). REQUIRED and disclosed if a Class B constraint is presented externally.

threshold.description: Confidence threshold below which the constraint escalates (Class B).

standard.description: The human-judgment standard invoked, e.g. 'commercially reasonable' (Class C).

allOf.$comment: registry-facing-requires-class-a: a registry_facing constraint MUST be class A.
